name: KPJ
recent: 近期公告主要为雇员公积金局（EPF）和退休基金局（KWAP）等大股东在2026年10月至11月期间的连续持股变动申报。同期，公司旗下Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital推出首个国际病人病房，并完成东南亚首例机器人辅助心脏手术。最新财报显示2026年6月30日季度营收和净利均实现环比和同比增长。
notable: Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital 推出 KPJ Healthcare 首个国际病人专属病房。
KPJ Healthcare 完成东南亚首例机器人辅助心脏手术。
雇员公积金局（EPF）、退休基金局（KWAP）、Johor Corporation 等大股东在2026年10月至11月期间多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 MYR 1,196,792,000，环比增长14.0%，同比增长16.9%；净利为 MYR 103,922,000，环比增长49.2%，同比增长26.6%；净利率从上一季度的6.6%升至8.7%。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly continuous shareholding changes by major shareholders such as EPF and KWAP between October and November 2026. Meanwhile, Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital launched the group's first international patient ward, and the group set a Southeast Asian record in robotic-assisted cardiac surgery. The latest financial results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 showed both revenue and net profit grew quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Ampang Puteri Specialist Hospital launched KPJ Healthcare's first dedicated international patient ward.
KPJ Healthcare performed Southeast Asia's first robotic-assisted cardiac surgery.
Major shareholders including EPF, KWAP and Johor Corporation filed multiple shareholding change notices between October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 1,196,792,000, up 14.0% quarter-on-quarter and 16.9% year-on-year; net income was MYR 103,922,000, up 49.2% quarter-on-quarter and 26.6% year-on-year; net margin rose to 8.7% from 6.6% in the previous quarter.
